description: Real shapes used by the W13 playlist work, copied byte-for-byte. browse-playlist.json is the W11 real ANONYMOUS capture of a public playlist (it carries per-row playlistSetVideoId on all 16 first-page rows and no edit affordance: it is the 'viewer' case; its greyed-out row has an occurrence id and no menu). kaset-playlist_detail.json is Kaset's Tests/KasetTests/Fixtures/playlist_detail.json, which is a HAND-WRITTEN test fixture (example.com thumbnails, ids like 'playlist-track-1'), NOT a signed capture; the brief called it a real signed fixture and it is not. It is used only to show a header-only layout is not misread as editable. The only real SIGNED capture available is Fixtures/W12-kaset-real/artist_lofi_girl_episodes_more.json, which shows the real ACTION_ADD_VIDEO action shape (addedVideoId, dedupeOption DEDUPE_OPTION_CHECK) inside playlistEditEndpoint; no signed capture of an editable playlist page or of ACTION_REMOVE_VIDEO/ACTION_MOVE_VIDEO_BEFORE exists.
